messages: I've organized this by budget, because a great gift doesn't have to be expensive. It just has to be right.

Book Lover Fuzzy Socks — The HAPPYPOP Book Lover Fuzzy Socks come with little bookshelf patterns. They're warm, they're soft, and they're the kind of thing a reader will actually use every single day. A perfect stocking stuffer or add-on gift.

Bookish Wine Glass — The "Too Many Books" Wine Glass is a stemless glass that says everything a romance reader believes. It's practical, it's funny, and it's the kind of gift that gets used at every reading night.

A Writing Candle — The Classical Library Candle is a beautiful, atmospheric candle with bergamot, amber, and sandalwood notes. It smells expensive and it's not. Perfect for the reader who loves a mood.

A Proper Book Light — The Glocusent LED Book Light is the gift that readers don't know they need until they have it. Multiple brightness settings, a flexible neck, and a long-lasting rechargeable battery. Around $20–25.
